notes.text: The second patronymic marker is printed בק, apparently an error for בן (“ben”); it remains unrepaired in the working text.

The saved named Davidson Shabbat 75b paragraph explicitly has Rabbi Shimon ben Kisma reporting Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. This supports contextual ben while the supplied בק remains visible. The comparison establishes neither a printed correction history nor a shared identity with the separately listed Yose ben Kisma.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1036) has Yose ben Kisma and Shimon bar Kisma under the Kisma heading. The supplied second entry reads בק. The consulted Bavli reads Yosei bar Kisma at Shabbat 152a and Shimon ben Kisma at Shabbat 75b, where Shimon reports in the name of Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. The two notices remain separate.
